questions.question: What is the main motivation for ecosystem accounting?

options.A: To measure the economic activities of ecosystems
options.B: To shed light on the non-market activities that relate to ecosystems
options.C: To track the size of an ecosystem asset in terms of spatial area
options.D: To record the value of stocks of assets given the expected flow of ecosystem services

questions.explanation: Ecosystem accounting aims to shed light on the non-market activities that relate to ecosystems and integrate this information with relevant market related data.

questions.question: What type of accounts are ecosystem service flows?
questions.explanation: Ecosystem service flows are flow variables, which help to understand the benefits derived from the ecosystems in the economy.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Ocean Accounts Framework?

options.A: To track the size of an ecosystem asset in terms of spatial area
options.B: To measure the quality of an ecosystem by tracking indicators of ecosystem health
options.C: To record the value of stocks of assets given the expected flow of ecosystem services
options.D: To integrate four key components: Macroeconomic Accounts, Environmental-Economic Accounts, Ecosystem Extent Accounts, and Ecosystem Condition Accounts

questions.explanation: The Ocean Accounts Framework integrates four key components: Macroeconomic Accounts, Environmental-Economic Accounts, Ecosystem Extent Accounts, and Ecosystem Condition Accounts.

questions.question: What is the main difference between ecosystem services accounts and the system of national accounts?

options.A: Ecosystem services accounts are based on transactions or actual exchanges in the economy
options.B: Ecosystem services accounts are not based on transactions or actual exchanges in the economy
options.C: Ecosystem services accounts are similar to the system of national accounts
options.D: Ecosystem services accounts are not similar to the system of national accounts

questions.explanation: Ecosystem services accounts are similar to the system of national accounts, which is based on transactions or actual exchanges in the economy.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Environmental-Economic Accounts?

options.A: To track the size of an ecosystem asset in terms of spatial area
options.B: To measure the quality of an ecosystem by tracking indicators of ecosystem health
options.C: To record the value of stocks of assets given the expected flow of ecosystem services
options.D: To explain the relationship between mankind and the environment

questions.explanation: The Environmental-Economic Accounts aim to explain the relationship between mankind and the environment.
